modern: If you work at what is in front of you, following right reason seriously, vigorously, calmly, without allowing anything else to distract you, but keeping your divine part pure, as if you were bound to give it back immediately; if you hold to this, expecting nothing, fearing nothing, but satisfied with your present activity according to nature, and with heroic truth in every word and sound you utter, you will live happily. And there is no man who is able to prevent this.
original: If thou workest at that which is before thee, following right reason seriously, vigorously, calmly, without allowing anything else to distract thee, but keeping thy divine part pure, as if thou shouldst be bound to give it back immediately; if thou holdest to this, expecting nothing, fearing nothing, but satisfied with thy present activity according to nature, and with heroic truth in every word and sound which thou utterest, thou wilt live happy. And there is no man who is able to prevent this.

explained.summary: If you get on with the task in front of you, guided by reason, seriously and calmly, without distraction, and keep your inner self clean as if you had to hand it back at any moment, you’ll live well. Expect nothing, fear nothing, be content with doing what’s right, and speak the truth boldly. Nobody can stop you from living like this.
explained.today: Washing up, writing a report or helping a child with homework can all be done this way: fully, honestly and without worrying about what you’ll get for it or what might go wrong tomorrow.
